author: Delaney Vega
title: North Bay Haven expands athletics with two new programs - NewsBreak
text:
By Delaney Vega No media credit provided. ,
1 days ago
LYNN HAVEN, Fla. ( WMBB ) – The Buccaneers are officially introducing two new programs beginning the 2026-2027 year.
North Bay Haven is adding beach volleyball and flag football to their athletic department.
The new Buccaneer beach volleyball program will be the fourth in Bay County, joining Arnold, Bay and Mosley. Beach volleyball is a spring sport that traditionally begins in early February and extends through April or early May.
And another girls’ sport heading to campus is flag football.
Flag football had its first official year in Bay County in the 2025-2026 season. So the Buccaneers will be joining Mosley, Rutherford, Arnold and Bay for the season. Flag is another spring sport that will begin in February.
